podcast.title: Joined The Coasters (1957)
podcast.body: Doug Jones joined The Coasters in 1957, replacing Bobby Nun, and became part of the classic lineup. "When we last left the coasters, they'd just taken on two new singers. Cornel Gunter and Doug Jones, to replace Leon Hughes and Bobby Nun."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Bass Solo Lines for The Coasters
podcast.body: Within the new Coasters lineup, Dub Jones consistently performed the bass solo lines in the group's songs. "Dub Jones would always take his bass solo lines."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Role in "Shopping for Clothes"
podcast.body: In The Coasters' reworked version of "Shopping for Clothes," Dub Jones played the role of the sales assistant in the song's dialogue. "The new version of the song was reworked significantly, and in particular it became a dialogue, with Billy Guy playing the shopper, and Dup Jones playing the sales assistant."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Voice Rooted in African American Comedy
podcast.body: Doug Jones's vocal parts in The Coasters' performances were noted for being clearly rooted in particular traditions of African American comedy. This style played with black culture and reappropriated stereotypes of black people. "The coasters performances, and especially Doug Jones' vocal parts, are very clearly rooted in particular traditions of African American comedy, and the way that that form of comedy plays with black culture and reappropriates stereotypes of black people."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
